_comment: Module map of this repository (owner decision, 2026-11-20: four modules; tests are not a module, each test file follows the code it tests). Same shape as the modules file the cockpit reads (--modules): modules[{id,name,desc}], assign[{path,module,basis?,candidates?,alias?}]. Longest matching path prefix wins (a path ending in '/' is a prefix, otherwise an exact file). module=null is an explicit 'unassigned'; 'candidates' (optional, decision data) lists the modules a file could equally belong to and changes no assignment; 'alias' marks a pseudo-path that is not a tracked file. Test files follow the mirrored source path (tests/tools/test_x.py -> tools/x.py), then an entry for the test path itself. A file that cannot be placed in a sub-module goes to the parent; a file ambiguous between modules stays null and is reported. Guard: tests/tools/test_cardmeta_map.py.
